items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Played with Solastain or anyone like that? Oh no, no, I don't believe, no, no.

ctx.x: Um, I was gonna ask if you can, anytime, this doesn't have to be in any special order, if you think of anything about your father later on or the bands he played with that might come to your mind, you can just interrupt whatever we're talking about. You don't have any idea which bands he played with?
No, well I don't. Don't. Played with Solastain or anyone like that? Oh no, no, I don't believe, no, no. No. I know my oldest brother, he used to play with, used to gig around with, kiddin' in there.
Oh, excuse the interruption again, but what, since uh, we're trying to get as much of the older history of the older men as possible too. What was your father's first name?
